t: The Magnusson Digital Angle Measurer is an essential tool for precise angle measurement and setting. This robust angle finder is ideal for carpentry, plumbing, metalwork, and general construction tasks, ensuring accurate results across various projects. Features a clear LCD display for easy readings and measures angles from 0 to 180° (with 0.2° accuracy). Strong magnetic base provides secure attachment to metal surfaces, while its IP54 water-resistant design offers durability on site. Auto power-off function conserves battery life.
b: Strong Magnetic Base for Secure Attachment
